published_statement: READ. Abstract: 'In each channel there is an inequality between information flow i and energy flow E  i2\<E'rr/(3h\~n22)  a relationship which, though speculated on before or derived for only a restricted class of systems, is proven here for a wide range of systems.' Eq. (16), p. 2166 (fermions): 'i', s (r/31n2 2)E+h-', (16) a relationship which is completely independent of the form of w(k) or any other physical parameter of the specific system.' Bosons, p. 2168: 'which is, remarkably, the same inequality obtained for fermions: the equality is not attainable with massive bosons, but only with massless objects such as photons or phonons.' Read through the OCR (and forced by reaudit (a)-(e)) this is I_dot^2 <= (pi/(3 ln^2 2)) E_dot_+ / hbar per channel, i.e. I_dot <= sqrt(pi E_dot/(3 hbar))/ln 2 -- IDENTICAL to branelink.py:38-39 and to S5 N(A) at branelink.py:350 (reaudit (a),(h)). Eq. (36), p. 2169, at optimum: 'S + - -1 6Irk;Tch-l E + - 1 2 k2 BT: \~ h-'.' = S_+ = pi k^2 T_c/(6 hbar), E_+ = pi k^2 T_c^2/(12 hbar), which saturates the bound (reaudit (b),(c)). Scope of the generality claim, p. 2164: 'Thus within the confines of the model it is, I believe, rigorous. Since the same law emerges under a wide range of circumstances it is tempting to speculate that it is a law of quantum thermodynamics, the ‘fourth law’, unproven in the general case but universally obeyed.' Conclusions p. 2171: 'I suspect that the inequality as applied to a single channel holds completely generally.'
published_hypotheses: S1 SINGLE CHANNEL (p. 2162-2163): 'It leaves us with no alternative but to concentrate on a single channel if we are to establish equation (5) on a sound footing.' 'Thus we define a single channel as corresponding to one of the variables needed to specify the flow of the medium into the receiver.' Parallel channels break it: 'By placing as many channels in parallel as we wish, we can arbitrarily reduce the energy expenditure for information transfer.'

S2 GAS OF INDEPENDENT PARTICLES (p. 2164): 'In most common systems in which information or entropy flows, the active medium is a gas of independent particles.' Interacting media are covered only by the conjecture quoted in published_statement.

S3 BALLISTIC CHANNEL WITH A GROUP VELOCITY (p. 2164): 'We further assume that a quantum number k can be found such that the particle velocity in the channel is U (w) = dw/dk. (10)' ... 'the assumption that k exists is not a trivial one and implies a symmetry to the transporting medium.' Disorder is argued, not proved: 'A rigorous quantum mechanical treatment of diffusion is beyond present techniques'.

S4 STATISTICS AND DISPERSION FREE -- this is Pendry's 'field-blind' clause (p. 2164): 'The important result of this section is that neither the statistics nor the dispersion relationship affects the inequality, though certain forms of w (k) may render the optimum case unattainable.' Gaps and band edges only lower the ratio ('Hence the enetgy flow is inevitably greater'; bosons: 'In the case that the spectrum does not extend to w = 0, the system is less efficient').

S5 INFORMATION = ENTROPY, NOISELESS, ISOLATED MEDIUM (pp. 2161, 2165): 'Identifying information with entropy (Shannon 1948, Brillouin 1956)'; 'In the case of information flow, T, is the information temperature and we shall assume that the medium is isolated from its surroundings. Thus we do not consider the case of classical information theory where the information competes with entropy from thermal excitations.'

S6 ONE-SOURCE FLUX, STEADY FLOW (pp. 2164-2165): 'The proof ... instead considers a steady flow of information'; flows labelled 'S, and E+ where the subscript '+' denotes that the flux originates from the '+' source'; 'Thus our work does not imply an inevitable energy expenditure, a conclusion which would require a detailed analysis of transmitter and receiver and which will not be attempted here.'
NOT IN THE SOURCE: no moving frame, no relativistic carrier, no bulk/brane geometry, no massive-carrier boost. The receiver is not analysed (S6).
hypothesis_drift: SUPERSEDED STATUS (branelink.py:39, :162-163 CLOSING_PREMISE_STATUS = 'NOT-FOUND', 'Pendry 1983, Bekenstein & Schiffer not read'): the FUNCTIONAL FORM is now READ at source (abstract; eq. 16) and matches the tree's sqrt(pi P/(3 hbar))/ln 2 exactly (reaudit (a)). 'NOT-FOUND' is stale for the form; it remains accurate for universal field-blindness, which Pendry calls 'unproven in the general case'. Recorded, not repaired.

'FIELD-BLIND' NARROWED (branelink.py:39-40): Pendry proves independence of statistics and dispersion (S4) only for a gas of independent particles in a ballistic channel with a group velocity (S2, S3), isolated and noiseless (S5). Beyond that it is his conjecture ('tempting to speculate', 'I suspect'). The tree carries none of S2-S5; it carries only 'single mode' and marks field-blindness 'not established' -- which is the correct reading.

THE REFUSED USE IS SUPPORTED BY THE SOURCE (branelink.py:40-42, failure mode (4)): Pendry's own parallelism argument (eqs. 6-7, p. 2162) is that N channels sharing E carry sqrt(N) times one channel (reaudit (g); first audit check 6). A carrier in a 5D bulk is not shown to be one channel, and Pendry treats no moving frame, so applying the single-channel form to 'a carrier with gamma > 1 on a moving brane in a 5D bulk' is not licensed by the paper. The first audit's massless-Doppler invariance (checks 5a-5c) is outside Pendry and remains the auditor's computation; the massive-carrier boost is still uncomputed.

'CAPACITY' (branelink.py:39): Pendry's quantity is an entropy flow identified with information for a noiseless isolated medium (S5); he does not analyse a receiver (S6). The tree's pairing with a LIGO-class receiver (branelink.py:31-33) bounds, it does not estimate -- as the first audit said; now confirmed from the source's own caveat.

PARTICLE STATISTICS: READ -- same bound for fermions (eq. 16) and bosons (p. 2168); equality only for massless bosons or a gapless Fermi band. Agrees with the first audit's computed Fermi-sea saturation (its check 4b) and with reaudit (i),(i').
branelink.py:350 (S5 N(A)) has no drift: identically Pendry's bound (reaudit (h)).

rederivation.outcome: 13 of 13 PASS (output pendry_reaudit.out). (a) Pendry's I^2 <= (pi/3 ln^2 2) E/hbar is identical to branelink's form. (b)-(c) eq. (36) is the massless 1D Bose flux, E = pi k^2 T^2/(12 hbar) (Bose integral pi^2/6 by quadrature), and saturates the bound. (d) eqs. (32)-(35): Q <= pi k^2 T^2/(3 hbar), optimum channel temperature Tc = 2T, and the 'one quarter' of eq. (37) for Tc = T. (e) dE/dT = pi^2 k^2 T/(3h), the conductance quantum -- with (c) this is what fixes the OCR glyph as hbar. (f) eq. (17)'s '10^-16 W' at 1e9 bit/s is the right order (4.8e-17 W); 1 W carries 1.44e17 bit/s. (g) eq. (7): N channels give sqrt(N). (h) N(A) at branelink.py:350 is Pendry's bound. (i) a band edge keeps the ratio below the ceiling. One first-run FAIL was mine (sympy left the Bose integral unevaluated); replaced by zeta(2) with a quadrature cross-check. The first audit's 27-check script was re-run this stage: ALL PASS.

lacked_data: Pendry in 1983 lacked measured single-channel conductance quanta (photons 2006, electrons 2013; still titles only here) and a Holevo-capacity argument (Caves-Drummond 1994, Blencowe-Vitelli 2000; still summaries only). What the source shows he did NOT lack is the result itself: the per-channel form is printed and his own generality claim is explicitly bounded ('unproven in the general case'). The narrowing is a hypothesis gap (S2-S5), not a data gap; hbar is the only constant and moves the ceiling by 8.0e-6 (first audit check 8).
grade_evidence: READ at source. The ceiling's form and constant are Pendry's eq. (16) and abstract, identical to branelink.py:38-39 and :350 (reaudit (a),(h)), and the optimum eq. (36) saturates it (b)-(c). What is NARROWED is the 'field-blind' premise: Pendry proves statistics- and dispersion-independence only for a gas of independent particles in a ballistic channel with a group velocity, noiseless and isolated from thermal entropy (S2-S5); beyond that, in his words, it is 'unproven in the general case' and 'I suspect that the inequality as applied to a single channel holds completely generally'. The tree's OWNER statement is not contradicted -- branelink refuses the pass's use, and Pendry's own parallel-channel argument (eqs. 6-7; sqrt(N), reaudit (g)) and his silence on moving frames support that refusal. One tree status is stale: CLOSING_PREMISE_STATUS = 'NOT-FOUND' (branelink.py:163) with 'Pendry 1983 ... not read' (:40) -- the form is now found; universal field-blindness is still not. Not WRONG: nothing contradicts; not STANDS: the premise as named ('field-blind' for a gamma > 1 bulk carrier) holds only under hypotheses the tree does not carry. Bekenstein & Schiffer remains NAMED-NOT-READ.
what_would_change_the_grade: STANDS for the premise would need a proof of the per-channel bound beyond free ballistic gases (interacting or diffusive media) plus a channel count for the bulk carrier and the massive-carrier boost; Bekenstein & Schiffer (IJMPC 1 (1990) 355) or Blencowe-Vitelli quant-ph/0001007 are where such an extension would be read. WRONG would need a single-channel counterexample inside S2-S5, of which none was found.
